records.original_stem:
A Massachusetts sterile pharmacy evaluates a preparation and its release conditions. No unmentioned USP exception or Board waiver is being used. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: A compounder assigns current categories by simply renaming the former low-, medium-, and high-risk labels.
A.finding_ko: USP의 공개 Q11–12는 category를 제조 환경·시간·추가품질요건으로 구별한다. 옛 low/medium/high를 이름만 바꾸는 일대일 치환이 아니다.

B.original_option_text: A facility assigns a longer-category BUD without the corresponding facility and testing conditions because the solution appears clear.
B.finding_ko: 용액 외관만으로 시설·시험·추가품질보증 조건을 충족하지 못한다. FAQ12는Category3의추가조건을명시한다.

C.original_option_text: A pharmacy treats one later passing result as sufficient to delete the original failure and omit investigation.
C.finding_ko: 이후 한 번 통과해도 원래실패를 삭제하거나 원인·영향조사를 생략하지 않는다. MA정책은실패미생물확인·조사능력을검토하도록한다.

D.original_option_text: A pharmacist evaluates stability throughout the intended use of a compounded implantable-pump preparation.

records.case_application_ko: 각 선택지는 별개 work-queue 기록이다. 적용 경로와 실제 행동을 개별 검토했다. 지지되는 선택지는 D이다.
records.blocker: 저자 검토상 개별 문항은 지지되는 정답을 갖는다. 단순 모델 반복만으로 불량 판정을 세지 않는다. 독립 legal/realism 감사와 canonical release 요건은 별도 미충족이다.

A pharmacist evaluates handling and sourcing controls. Hazardous-drug exposure, controlled-substance scheduling, and FDA outsourcing registration are distinct classifications. C.original_option_text: A pharmacy uses gloves labeled only as nitrile without confirming the required chemotherapy-glove test performance.

D.original_option_text: A hospital distinguishes an appropriately registered 503B outsourcing facility’s supply pathway from a traditional 503A pharmacy’s pathway.
